title: Freed ID mdoc session-transcript, reader-authentication, and namespace-disclosure profile
hypothesis: A synthetic mdoc profile can reject a presentation when the device response is not bound to the expected session transcript and handover, reader authentication is missing or mismatched, or disclosed namespace elements exceed the authorized request.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate transcript digest, handover, verifier origin, nonce, reader-auth state, namespace, element request, disclosed set, device-auth state, and claim class; unbound, excessive, unauthenticated, or promoted rows must fail.
evidence_class: bounded structural or proxy software evidence
boundary: Acceptance is confined to the declared synthetic tribunal and does not promote empirical, participant, identity, authority, privacy, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
